messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@clearshift.ai>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request to reopen expired trial due to procurement delay

Hi Olga —

We were running Redwood in a sandbox and the trial credits expired last week. Our procurement team hit a snag around invoicing and we lost runway to finish the POC. We still need to validate your streaming latency improvements for our real-time summarization flow before we sign. Is there any way to reopen the trial or get a short-term extension of credits while procurement finalizes the PO?

I can share the procurement timeline if that helps. Ideally we’d like a two-week window to complete the final tests and a follow-up demo with our CTO.

Thanks —
Samantha Ortiz
Senior Product Manager, ClearShift
S: (415) 555-0198

Attachment: procurement-timeline.pdf (summary of purchasing milestones)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@clearshift.ai>
Cc: Mark Li <mark.li@clearshift.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to reopen expired trial due to procurement delay

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the context and the timeline — I read the attachment. Totally understand how procurement timing can derail a POC. We can help.

Quick proposal: we can reactivate a one-time temporary credit bundle for 14 days (equivalent to 200k tokens) to let you finish the latency tests and run the CTO demo. To do this I need a short note from your procurement stating expected PO date (next steps) and a single point of contact for sign-off. If that’s in place I’ll start the approval thread on our side.

If you prefer, we can also schedule a 30-minute call later today to align on what you’ll validate so I can provision the appropriate model / instance size. My availability: 2pm or 4pm PT.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | (415) 555-0127

--
Olga Petrov
Redwood Inference
